scope.summary: Add the optional description and documentation-link field to StudioComponent, StudioComponentInstance, StudioStyleRegistry entries, and StudioVariable, surfaced in the operator asset browser, the instance inspector, and the model/UserManual surfaces. This is one shared contract across all three primitive families, not three separate fields.
acceptance_criteria: shared description + documentation-link across components/styles/variables; inspector + model surfaces; author_id + manual entry
expected_tests: argus: description + documentation-link editable in inspector via author_id
test: shared contract present on component/instance/style/variable; persists to authority; surfaced to model read API

target_entries: Studio / Design Systems / Describing and documenting assets

risk_if_missed: No description/doc-link surface; design-system assets undiscoverable and undocumented.

risks: Scaffold-only claim without runtime proof (Spec-Realism Gate).
Domain MT forking a canonical primitive instead of referencing 14.23.
PostgreSQL/SQLite creep or a write that bypasses the typed SurrealDB boundary on a studio_* authority path.
minimum_controls: At least one proof command exercises executable runtime or a Handshake-managed resource boundary.
Reference canonical primitives (14.23); no shadow primitives.
no_legacy_database_tripwire plus typed-SurrealDB-boundary proof on every authority write.
